description: This file contains utility functions and classes for parsing and formatting HTTP headers, including URI parsing, character checks, and token handling, used in WebSocket header processing.

classes.name: ParsingState
classes.description: Maintains the current parsing position within a data string.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the character at a specific position from the current head without advancing the position.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Consumes a specified number of characters from the current position and advances the head.

methods.name: consume_string
methods.description: Consumes a specific string from the current position if it matches.

methods.name: consume_lws
methods.description: Consumes linear whitespace (LWS) from the current position.

methods.name: consume_token
methods.description: Consumes an HTTP token from the current position.

methods.name: consume_token_or_quoted_string
methods.description: Consumes either a token or a quoted string, returning the unquoted string.

methods.name: quote_if_necessary
methods.description: Quotes a string if it contains special characters or control characters.

methods.name: parse_uri
methods.description: Parses a URI into hostname, port, and resource path.
